entities.summary: Jonas Brodin is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). After recording four assists through 42 games as a 17-year-old in the Swedish Hockey League, Brodin was drafted in the first round, 10th overall, by the Wild in the 2011 NHL entry draft.
